subject: Data location when placed in cloud

messages.author: a518a8a90723450e
messages.subject: Data location when placed in cloud
parts:
Hi,

I have a question regarding shinyapps.io. When I upload my app on the cloud and the user has data in his server which he needs to upload in order to use the app then does the data move from user's server to shinyapps.io cloud and stays there or simply stays in the user's server which uses the app to analyse the data via browser?

Thank you

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Data location when placed in cloud
parts: If the user is uploading data to the application, it is actually going to be in the cloud.  Shiny as a framework runs on the server, with the front end UI being in the browser but all the processing is in the backend.
